generator.rng_algorithm: ChaCha20 (rand_chacha 0.9.0), 256-bit key, stream=0, word_pos=0; next_u64 low-u32 first
generator.uniform_f64_rule: (next_u64() >> 11) as f64 * 2^-53; two calls per cell: axis_1 then axis_2
generator.cell_order: axis_2 outer j=0..n2, axis_1 inner i=0..n1; results in prepare_rays canonical order
